# Context callback element result

Owned Java 8 private helper: one complete fixed-context-to-own-formal callback alongside an independent fixed frame argument. Original field reads snapshot a full-width frame value before callback mutation, preserving frame identity, null failure order and partial writes. The method's actual return remains independent of callback output.

Source and SDK-input profiles freeze callers and originals, account for definitions, compile all generated Java, compare metadata/Exceptions and cover four routes, 21 modes twice, five Signature controls and ten independent wrong programs. The extra frame is not treated as a generic seed.
